method: PyMuPDF vector extraction of KEY MARK & MATERIAL plans (p9 B1 1/150, p21 2F 1/120, p41 3F 1/120). Scale from CEN/015-치수선 extension-line x/y coordinates vs dimension text (2F/3F 31400, 19900, 1200, 6600; B1 39200/7800/6100/7300 decoded from broken font) — all checks agree within 0.04%. Boundary layers rasterised at ~21 mm/px (2F/3F) and ~19.6 mm/px (B1): wall, wal, WID, COR, CONW, AR-창호, FL-FRAME, I-Door Frame, I-DOOR, ELEV, E3, black FL-DOOR, door; COL layer only for columns (0.72pt) and long (>=40pt) black finish/wall lines in small groups; filled '.' hatches; CEN door-swing polylines; '0' filled dash segments (3F dash-dot partitions). Door-swing arcs are replaced by their two radii so openings close on the wall line. 7px morphological close seals hairline gaps. Flood fill (4-conn) from every room-name and finish-tag text position; area = pixels + half the contour length (boundary-line correction) x (mm/px)^2 = net (안목) area, columns automatically excluded. Finish code = 2-line tag (number over letters, e.g. 02/DT -> DT-02) inside the filled region. Regions holding >1 room name or code = open_group; their area is apportioned per code by (a) eroding free space by 800 mm to cut at doorways/necks, (b) geodesic nearest-marker growth (markers = finish tags + uncoded room names such as TOILET/탕비실). No BOQ/내역서 data was opened. Scripts: D:\Users\Portfolio\작업\10_진행중\conpa-demo\scripts\vector\ (measure_rooms.py, build_reference.py, finalize.py).

limitations: Areas are net floor (안목) areas inside boundary lines at ~20 mm/px raster; expected error about ±1-2% for rooms >10 m2, worse for rooms <5 m2.

open_group per-code splits (2F OPEN-2F-3/9, 3F OPEN-3F-2/3) are geometric apportionments between tags, not drawn boundaries. Group totals are reliable; splits are approximate (±10-20 m2 possible in 3F OPEN-3F-2 between DT-02 corridor/lounge and DT-03 office).
Untagged team names in open offices inherit the nearest tag. 3F 대회협력실(4名) has no tag and was split DT-02/DT-03 by geometry; it is likely all DT-03 in reality.

Stairs (주계단실/부계단실), EV shaft, P.S and unlabeled spaces were not measured. On B1, the large unlabeled west/south open area (no room names or tags on p9) and the toilets were not measured, so B1 totals cover only the named rooms.

Enclosed rooms without a finish tag (B1 준비실, 이사장실, 방송실, 기사대기실, ELE'V HALL; 2F 직원휴게실, INFO'MATION, O.A ROOM; 3F O.A ROOM) are code null even where a finish text note exists (B1 기사대기실 '~DELUXE TILE FIN.', 2F 직원휴게실 '~DECO TILE FIN.'). That is about 21 m2 that a BOQ might count under DE-01/DT-02.
B1 서고 includes the passage in front of 방송실; B1 법률구조재단 (DT-01) includes the lobby strip in front of 이사장실/준비실. Each may be 2-4 m2 high.
2F 금고 tag reads DE-01 but its text note says P-TILE FIN.; the tag value is used as-is.

3F scale reuses the 2F dimension evidence (identical dimension strings and CEN coordinates on p41). B1 dimension text uses a broken font, decoded by digit substitution (W=0, Y=2, Z=3, [=4, ]=6, ^=7, _=8, `=9, 1/5 partial).
